howTitle: Good lunch starts the night before.
howBody: A little planning, fresh ingredients and an easy WhatsApp message bring it all together.
stepOneBody: Our home chefs plan the next day’s menu the previous night, around fresh produce from the market.
stepTwoBody: Message us on WhatsApp before 9:00 AM to ask about the day’s home-cooked options.
stepThreeBody: We prepare your meal for delivery in Jaffna Town between 12:00 PM and 2:00 PM.
menuEyebrow: MADE AT HOME, SHARED WITH YOU
menuBody: A few favourites from the flavours of Jaffna. Ask us what’s cooking today.
menuVegBody: Rice served with a comforting mix of seasonal vegetables, greens and home-style sides.
menuBiryaniBody: Fragrant, slow-cooked layers with warming spices and the feeling of a special home meal.
menuRiceBody: Colourful rice dishes, gently tempered with familiar spices, herbs and a little crunch.
menuCurryBody: Slow-simmered, flavourful curries inspired by the tastes and traditions of Jaffna.
